variants.name: embedded-sse-recovery-verification
variants.description: Bounded verification receipt for named embedded SSE delivery, single-connection recovery, upstream projection reactivity, and source dependency build order

notes: The embedded adapter consumes named entity.change events and maps valid server payloads once.
The failed EventSource is closed before one capped replacement and unsubscribe cancels recovery.
The browser proof instruments the application EventSource and observes one visible post-reconnect Knowledge update.
The normalized React projection defect is fixed upstream rather than bypassed in UAR.
The full frontend test command retains its unrelated 10-test failure instead of being represented as passing.
